modifier_definitions.normfactor: Free multiplicative scale factor applied to all bins of the sample. Non-negative. No constraint term in the likelihood.
modifier_definitions.normsys: Normalization systematic. Nuisance parameter alpha has a standard normal prior N(0,1). For alpha >= 0, yield is scaled by kappa_hi^alpha; for alpha < 0, yield is scaled by kappa_lo^(-alpha).
modifier_definitions.histosys: Shape systematic via template morphing. Nuisance parameter alpha has a standard normal prior N(0,1). For alpha >= 0, yield_i = nominal_i + alpha * (hi_i - nominal_i). For alpha < 0, yield_i = nominal_i + alpha * (nominal_i - lo_i).
